fields.System.Title: CNT-504 — Unfreeze the warehouse
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want operations to resume once the count is posted, so
that the warehouse restarts cleanly on correct numbers.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given all counts are posted, when I unfreeze, then every blocked operation becomes
  • available again.
  • - Given outstanding uncounted locations, then unfreezing is rejected until they are
  • counted or explicitly skipped.
  • - Given unfreezing, then it is recorded with the acting user and the time.
  • - Given unfreezing, then allocation re-evaluates orders that were waiting on stock.
  • - Given a week later, then a verification count of a sample of locations is scheduled
  • automatically.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | freeze state |
| Risks | Unfreezing with locations uncounted; no verification count ([doc 08 §8](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
